title: Capacity Scenario Catalog & Decision Tree for Cycle Commitments
creator: Ava Nguyen
description: Goal: produce a compact, operational catalog of capacity scenarios and an actionable decision tree that PMs and Eng leads can use during cycle commit reviews. Deliverables: (1) scenario catalog spreadsheet (best/expected/worst + assumptions), (2) decision tree diagram (SVG + one-page Confluence), (3) a scope-cut runbook with three preset recipes (low/medium/high impact), and (4) a staffing matrix example mapping roles to surge lanes. Scope: focus on the three core workload families we operate (hosted API latency-sensitive, Dedicated throughput-focused, Private/VPC upgrade windows). Out of scope: detailed infra provisioning automation (that will be handled as follow-on ENG tickets).
